environment.server: Vite production Node artifact with generated local runtime secrets and development service configuration; no external providers used

evidence: Alice assigns through the team issue detail; two independently authenticated Bob browser contexts open the same issue UUID and team number in Assigned.
Bob edits the title in My issues; Alice sees the committed title in team details and the other Bob context reloads the same title.
Created and Subscribed use actor-owned durable state across sessions. Subscribe/unsubscribe propagates on focus refresh.
Private team membership revoked while Bob has a list preview and another device has a full personal detail open.

Explicit queue refresh clears the row and preview; focus refresh clears the direct detail. SPA navigation through Created, Subscribed, Assigned and Activity returns zero rows without restoring private titles.

Client regression tests assert canonical cached-record eviction after empty and failed revalidation, stale in-flight response rejection, concurrent retained detail hiding and same-revision access recovery.
PostgreSQL checks assert live authorization for all personal scopes, no private IDs/counts/facets, redacted details, rejected writes and rejected revoked sessions.
